args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Per the runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions. The rollback reports v2.3.0 rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production; v2.3.1-rc (staging, also unhealthy) was not involved in the rollback. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health checks recover on v2.3.0, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging, where it is also unhealthy.
- **Rollback result:** The rollout reported v2.3.0 in all three regions.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open at SEV2. Its summary describes the v2.3.1 failure (error rate 0.18), the rollback, and the follow-ups.

I haven't re-checked service health since the rollback, so recovery is unconfirmed. Next steps are to confirm the error rate and health checks are back to normal on v2.3.0, and to investigate v2.3.1 before it is redeployed.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
